item.title: IGP Denies Arrest of Peaceful Protesters in Edo
item.description: Kayode Egbetokun, the inspector-general of police (IGP), has dismissed claims that police officers arrested peaceful protesters in Ekpoma, Edo state. He said the 52 suspects taken into custody were involved in criminal acts during the protest. Speaking on Crime Buster with Desmond, episode six, on Saturday, Egbetokun said the police were frequently blamed for incidents of violence that occurred under the cover of protests. “That’s the usual false narrative against the police. item.title: Fuji Singer Destiny Boy Dies at 22
item.description: Destiny Boy, the Nigerian singer, has passed away at the age of 22. News of his sudden passing broke on Sunday after distressing footage, showing his body being transported to a mortuary, circulated widely on social media. The clips sparked an outpouring of grief and speculation about the cause of his death. item.title: Oborevwori to governors: States receiving more money from FAAC, make people happy
item.description: Sheriff Oborevwori, governor of Delta, says states now receive more in federation allocations. He added that “some people” should stop claiming that there is no money. The Federation Account Allocation Committee (FAAC) is tasked with disbursing money to the three tiers of government in line with an agreed revenue sharing formula. item.title: Police arrest three suspects linked to killing of mother and her six children in Kano
item.description: The Kano state police command has arrested three suspects in connection with the murder of a housewife and her six children at Dorayi Chiranchi quarters in Kano municipal LGA. The arrests followed a directive from Kayode Egbetokun, the inspector-general of police, and were carried out in an intelligence-led operation overseen by Ibrahim Bakori, Kano commissioner of police. item.title: Senegal beat Morocco to win AFCON 2025
item.description: Senegal has won the Africa Cup of Nations AFCON 2025 following a dramatic 1-0 extra-time victory over host Morocco at the Prince Moulay Abdellah Stadium on Sunday.
